gaps.title: Continuous Paley-Wiener domain
gaps.detail: The finite bump and lift spaces are not yet embedded in a rigorously specified continuous Hilbert-domain extremal problem.
gaps.next_action: Define the compact-support Sobolev or Paley-Wiener domain, structural-zero subspace, and coercive tail functional.

gaps.title: Reproducing-kernel duality
gaps.detail: Discrete dual measures appear stable but have not been derived from a continuous kernel dual or KKT system.
gaps.next_action: Derive value, derivative, complex-core, and tail kernels and state strong-duality assumptions.

gaps.title: Galerkin convergence
gaps.detail: Observed dictionary saturation may be a basis artifact; no convergence theorem or a posteriori error estimate exists.
gaps.next_action: Prove density and objective convergence, or construct computable upper and lower error bounds.

gaps.title: Continuous axis supremum
gaps.detail: All axis audits remain discrete; v0.4 already demonstrated a coarse-grid false escape.
gaps.next_action: Use derivative bounds, adaptive global maximization, or interval enclosures on every band.

gaps.title: Fourier and tail interval transfer
gaps.detail: Fourier transforms, second-derivative tail matrices, and eigenvalues use floating quadrature.
gaps.next_action: Enclose matrix entries and propagate errors to directed eigenvalue bounds.

gaps.title: Full refined-cover joint exhaustion
gaps.detail: The new dictionaries were tested on the inherited difficult pilot patch, not all 288 refined patches.
gaps.next_action: Exhaust only after a continuous or new finite model crosses the current difficult-patch gate.

gaps.title: Alternative external dictionaries
gaps.detail: The subspace theorem does not exclude external atoms beyond the tested spectral-slope family.
gaps.next_action: Derive any future atoms from the continuous extremal or its kernel residual, not from unguided parameter expansion.

gaps.title: Theorem-backed zero counts and arithmetic tail
gaps.detail: Published floating count constants are inherited, but hypotheses and directed rounding are not theorem objects.
gaps.next_action: Create interval-evaluated count majorants and a theorem-backed tail bound.

gaps.title: Arithmetic histogram error
gaps.detail: No certified interpolation error is attached to the prime-side histogram model.
gaps.next_action: Bound kernel derivatives per bin and accumulate a directed matrix error.

gaps.title: Unknown off-axis leakage regions
gaps.detail: The complete zero-side regional budget outside the target patch remains unclosed.
gaps.next_action: Partition all orbit-type regions and attach a validated sign or leakage bound.

gaps.title: Zero presence and winding
gaps.detail: No argument-principle object proves a zero exists in a selected target patch.
gaps.next_action: Attach validated winding only after the global budget architecture is viable.

gaps.title: Local-to-global RH closure
gaps.detail: No formally checked implication closes all quantifiers from local finite objects to RH.
gaps.next_action: Build and verify the complete theorem dependency graph.
